Buy only from the official ticketing platform: the organisers have not announced it yet, and we will link it here when they do.

Matches in Nairobi

Avoid fake tickets

  • Buy only from the official siteIgnore sellers on social media and WhatsApp groups.
  • Never pay a person by M-Pesa for a ticketOfficial sales do not ask you to send money to a personal number.
  • Check the ticket rulesID and name-on-ticket rules will be added once the organisers publish them.
